departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Organizational units, their hierarchy and department heads.

departments.emptyDescription: Add your first department or import the structure from a spreadsheet.

jobTitles.title: Job titles
jobTitles.description: Job titles used across employee records, reports and certificates.
jobTitles.createDescription: Add a job title that can be assigned to employees.
jobTitles.emptyDescription: Add job titles one by one or import them from a spreadsheet.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Offices, sites and branches where employees work.
locations.createDescription: Add an office, site or branch.
locations.emptyDescription: Add your offices and sites or import them from a spreadsheet.

costCenters.title: Cost centers
costCenters.description: Cost centers used for reporting, business trips and budgeting.
costCenters.createDescription: Add a cost center for reporting and allocations.
costCenters.emptyDescription: Add cost centers one by one or import them from a spreadsheet.
